raw.details:
IDEAVERSE — IDEATHON 2026

Innovate • Ideate • Impact

Bring Your Idea. Build the Solution. Create the Impact.

QUICK LINKS

WhatsApp Group:

https://chat.whatsapp.com/KTpcvhaIx1b4RSM5RvHJgF?s=cl&p=a&mlu=4&ilr=4

Google Form Registration:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe6l9S6MA_6LBrOsN8Nm-ZUWNsd-FveBGmUrZxe5ON9Nh89kQ/viewform

EVENT OVERVIEW

Location: KIET Deemed to be University, Muradnagar, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh

Date: 06 October 2026

Reporting/Start Time: 09:45 AM IST onwards

Mode: Offline

Team Size: 1–3 members

Domain: Applied Research

Prize Pool: Up to ₹15,000

ABOUT THE EVENT

Have an idea that can solve a real-world problem? IDEAVERSE — IDEATHON 2026 gives students a platform to transform their thoughts into impactful, technology-driven solutions.

Participants will:

* Understand and analyze a given problem statement

* Develop an innovative solution

* Explain the working and implementation of their proposed solution

* Answer questions from the judges

The event focuses on:

Innovation, Problem-solving, Feasibility, Creativity, and Real-world impact.

Ideas may belong to domains such as:

Technology, Sustainability, Education, Healthcare, Smart Systems, Robotics, Applied Research, or any other relevant domain.

WHO CAN REGISTER / PARTICIPATE

  • Undergraduate students from any college are eligible to participate
  • Intercollegiate teams are eligible
  •  Interdisciplinary teams are permitted
  • *Each team may have 1–3 participants
  • *One participant cannot be part of multiple teams

PROBLEM STATEMENT

The problem statement will be provided by the organising team and released along with the event on the day of the ideathon. Participants are required to understand and analyze the given problem statement and develop an innovative, practical, and feasible solution addressing the identified problem.

EVENT STRUCTURE — IDEATHON CHALLENGE

The event will be conducted in a single offline round at KIET Deemed to be University, Ghaziabad.

Participants will be required to:

 

  •  Understand and analyze the given problem statement
  • Develop an innovative solution
  • Explain the working and implementation of the proposed solution
  •  Answer questions from the judges

Participants may use the following to strengthen their presentation:

Technology, Research, Business models, Prototypes, Diagrams, Supporting material

PITCHING GUIDELINES

Each team will be given a limited amount of time to present their idea. The presentation should clearly cover:

1. Problem Statement — Clearly define and demonstrate your understanding of the given problem statement

2. Proposed Solution— Explain the proposed solution and how it addresses the given problem statement

3. Innovation & Uniqueness — Highlight what makes the idea innovative and different from existing solutions

4. Working / Implementation — Explain how the proposed solution will work and how it can be implemented in the real world

5. Technology Used— Mention the technologies, tools, platforms, or research involved

6. Feasibility— Explain whether the solution is technically and practically feasible

7. Social / Environmental / Economic Impact — Describe the potential impact of the solution

8. Future Scope — Explain how the solution can be improved, expanded, or scaled in the future

 

Note: The exact presentation and questioning time will be communicated by the organising team.

EVALUATION CRITERIA

Teams may be evaluated based on:

Innovation & Creativity — Originality and creative approach of the idea

Problem Understanding — Relevance and clarity of the team's understanding of the given problem statement

Technical Feasibility — Practicality of implementing the proposed technology

Practical Implementation — Ability to implement the solution in real-world scenarios

Impact & Scalability— Potential social, environmental, or economic impact and scalability

Presentation & Communication— Clarity and effectiveness of the pitch

Overall Potential of the Idea — Overall usefulness and potential of the proposed solution

EVENT DETAILS

Date: 06 October 2026

Reporting/Start Time: 09:45 AM IST onwards

Mode: Offline

Venue: KIET Deemed to be University, Ghaziabad

Team Size: 1–3 participants

RULES AND REGULATIONS

  •  Participants must report to the venue before the designated reporting time
  •  Participants must carry a valid college ID card
  • Each participant can be a member of only one team
  •  Teams must follow the instructions and time limits provided by the organising team
  •  Ideas presented should be original and should not knowingly violate intellectual-property rights
  • Any form of unfair practice or misrepresentation may lead to disqualification
  •  Participants must maintain proper etiquette while interacting with organisers and judges
  • The organising team reserves the right to modify event rules if required
  • The decision of the judging panel and organising team regarding the final results will be considered final
  • Further information and updates will be communicated through the official event communication channels.

REWARDS

Total Prize Pool: Up to ₹15,000

All eligible participants will also receive participation certificates as per the event's certificate policy.
